description: Signed answer ($0.01) for a person's agent (principal.kind person): does the CPF you already have match the e-CPF holder behind it? On a match, a subject_ref of your own for that person (stable for you, different for every verifier). The CPF is never stored, published or revealed; 3 non-matching answers per credential stop your checks. The person sees every check.

cpf.description: The CPF you already have for this person; used for the comparison only, never stored.

name: kya_principal_match
